slices.focus: Saira wins Peter's backing for equipment after proving the prep window's impact with three months of timing data
slices.summary: Saira uses three months of stopwatch timings and queue notes to prove the protected repeat-prep window reduces the after-school bottleneck. Peter approves clearer basket dividers and a dedicated label printer for the repeat station. Saira plans a tiny proof loop to track the new baseline.
open_loops: Tiny proof loop (queue peak + repeat basket split) needs to be established
Short follow-up for Peter after equipment settles not yet done
Need to resist adding more improvements while momentum is high
decisions: Saira remained operations lead and won Peter's backing for modest equipment and clearer basket separation after proving
